title: File explorer: no panels, full screen at any path/fs

message.text: Taken: I'm rebuilding the file explorer without Panels, with a real folder tree, plus a full-screen view at any path ending in /fs. Two Sonnet minions will build it in a separate worktree, and I'll judge their work before it merges.

Two Sonnet minions are briefed: one removes Panels and builds a real folder tree, and the other adds the full-screen /fs view with a Files link on every page. Both are waiting in Servex's queue until enough memory frees up, and they will start by themselves.

Audit's done — the tree was already real (nested folders), it just never closed, and the "primitive toolbar" is actually two stacked bars: files.js's own column-mode switcher, plus ext/Panel's whole Workspace management bar (add/fullscreen/zoom) riding along underneath it. Now stripping Panel out and building the real expand/collapse tree with plain resizable columns.

My half is committed (f250ef84 on worktree/file-explorer-fs): ext/Panel is gone from ext/files, folders really open and close now (lazy past a depth, so fs.js can hand it thousands of paths), and two-or-three columns resize with a plain ext/grip seam. Zero new console errors on the files page, the Doc Files tab, ai2 and /start/. Audit + before/after shots are in the task's minion-a folder. One thing outside my fence: ext/demo/page.js still describes the removed column-mode bar in its own words — flagged for a follow-up, doesn't error.
